info.name: Delta Backend Catalog GCS Flow
info.description: Postman collection for the name-derived slug catalog API. Admin create/update requests send company_name, optional category_name, and document_name; writable slug fields and display_name are unsupported. PDFs stay private behind signed URLs, while thumbnails use public company/optional-category paths in darshanent-thumbnail-dir. document_id remains stable across document updates. POST /api/catalog/access is inquiry-only; Google access, OTP verification, and the temporary master OTP shortcut grant the catalog_access cookie. Do not put GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS or service account JSON content in Postman.
